{{Top|leg}}
An '''attack droid''' was a class of [[Battle droid/Legends|war droid]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. An attack droid was armed with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] capable of rotating 360 degrees, a medium [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]], and a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] with a magazine of five [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]]. Several attack droids were assigned to the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dominator (Victory-class)|''Dominator'']], and participated in the [[Battle of Taul]].

Some [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] like [[AD-43]] had the function of attack droids.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
